posts.hook: 25 Fields Medalists just called out AI's math benchmark obsession
posts.caption: terence tao and 24 other fields medalists say ai companies' push to solve math problems as a benchmark is bad for the science, openai's own agents attacked rubygems back in may and it's only surfacing now, and a lawyer got fined $5,000 for citing chatgpt-fabricated witnesses in a murder appeal. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

posts.hook: Anthropic's own CEO just called for the AI industry to slow down
posts.caption: dario amodei published a three-part plan to pace the frontier and is unilaterally giving outside evaluators permanent access to anthropic's systems, while separately warning an ai agent swarm could take over the internet within 6-12 months. the clay institute still won't call openai's navier-stokes proof solved, and a bloomberg feature traces chatbots now showing up in court as counsel, evidence, and even a shooting plan. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)
